newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon economic activity rises in June.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon economic activity rises in June.

text.p: Lebanon's economic activity rose in June to its highest level in eight months, the Bank of Lebanon said in its latest monthly bulletin on Tuesday.
The central bank said its indicator of economic activity rose to 168.8 -- its highest level since October when it was 168.9. In June last year the indicator was 156.9.
The indicator, which takes January 1993 as 100, combines 12 economic series including imports, exports, electricity output and airport and port activity.
The country's balance of trade registered a deficit of $506.1 million in June --bringing the mid-year deficit to $3 billion compared with $3.185 in the first half of 1995.
June imports were $580.6 million, up 3.3 percent on a year-on-year basis, and exports were $74.5 million -- registering a yearly rise of 3.2 percent.
Foreign debt rose $12 million in June to $1.526 billion. Net total public debt rose 313.4 billion Lebanese pounds to 13,637 billion pounds against 13,324 in May.
